operations.title: Run Python in Maya
operations.summary: Run *code* in the console namespace, as the next snippet typed into a console.

code.description: Python source: statements, then optionally an expression whose value comes back. Names it defines stay for later calls.

operations.title: An image of the scene
operations.summary: An image of the scene: a playblast of the current frame to a PNG in pythontk's temp root, with the scene left as it was (the persp camera, the selection, the undo queue and the unsaved-changes flag).

objects.description: The objects to frame, through the persp camera's view (default: the whole scene). Ignored with *camera*.

camera.description: A camera to look through (its transform or shape) instead.
